limitations: Authored local Markdown links are conservatively assigned the exact `normalized` status and emitted as dcterms:references; domain-specific predicates require separately authored evidence and are not inferred from link placement or prose.

The YAML-LD and JSON-LD graph is authoritative for directed relationships. Its entity nodes are an intentionally selected-field, lossy projection containing semantic identity and type plus `route`, `title`, `description`, `status` and `source_document`; authored Markdown remains authoritative for complete prose, source metadata and navigation richness, while the generated Explorer projection preserves the selected reader fields.

The `semantic_layer.outputs` list enumerates only artefacts that have governed Bundle Wiki v1 semantic or Reader roles. The static publication additionally generates `bundle/index.html`, `bundle/checksums.json`, the copied root surfaces `bundle/index.md`, `bundle/sources-index.md`, `bundle/log.md` and `bundle/okf.config.json`, and copied Markdown under `bundle/document/**/*.md`, `bundle/federated/**/*.md`, `bundle/frameworks/**/*.md`, `bundle/glossary/**/*.md`, `bundle/organisations/**/*.md`, `bundle/research/**/*.md`, `bundle/stack/**/*.md`, `bundle/standards/**/*.md` and `bundle/uk-government/**/*.md`. Repository-contract v1 has no truthful generic static-publication role for those HTML, Markdown and configuration outputs, so they are scoped here rather than mislabelled: `bundle/checksums.json` binds every other published file by exact path, byte count and SHA-256, while `scripts/check_publication.py` validates that exact file set, the checksum manifest and every byte-exact source/configuration copy.

A conformant local semantic receipt establishes deterministic build and validation status only; public deployment, release identity and live Reader behaviour remain separate release gates and are not proved by this contract.
